rv.q: This proud regicide, Dragutin Dimitrijevic, a real-life figure in Balkans history, burns at the center of Archduke , an interesting, nicely written, yet not especially satisfying new drama from Rajiv Joseph.
Intentionally inducing tonal whiplash, Archduke gets at the pathetic underpinnings of our current situation without nudging the audience too roughly.

vr.q: I thought the writing was sharp and the performances were great.
I really enjoyed this play. If it sounds interesting to you, please check it out.
